opportunities.name: Account brief from SEC + Wikipedia emailed
opportunities.description: For a given company ticker, look up the latest 10-K on SEC EDGAR, get HQ/employees/CEO from Wikipedia, and draft an 'Account brief' email to dana.
steps: Search ticker on SEC EDGAR company search and select the result
Filter filings by Form 10-K and note latest annual report filing date
Search company name on Wikipedia and open article
Read HQ, employee count, CEO from infobox
Compose email to dana@example.com with subject 'Account brief: <Company> (<TICKER>)'
Type body summarizing HQ, employees, CEO, latest 10-K date
Discard/send draft

instances.values: HUBS / HubSpot (in progress, no email seen)

opportunities.name: Supplier quote currency comparison + local time email
opportunities.description: Convert two supplier quote amounts in different currencies to USD on Xe, check the supplier city's local time on timeanddate, and email procurement with the cheaper option.
steps: Open Xe currency converter
Enter amount 1 and currency, convert to USD
Enter amount 2 and currency, convert to USD
Compare results to find cheaper
Open timeanddate world clock, search supplier city, read local time
Compose email to procurement@example.com with subject 'Quotes: <item>' and body with conversions, cheaper, supplier time
Discard/send

instances.values: 12500 EUR vs 1950000 JPY, Osaka, CNC enclosures
8200 GBP vs 780000 INR, Pune, Shipping boxes
partial: 64000/14500 INR->CNY etc., no email yet

opportunities.name: Timezone difference + holiday avoidance sync email
opportunities.description: For two cities and a month, get the time difference from timeanddate converter and the holidays of the country, then email ops with sync constraints.
steps: Open Time Zone Converter
Add city A and city B
Read time difference
Open Calendar > Holidays, pick country
Identify holidays in the target month
Compose email to ops@example.com with subject 'Sync: <A> / <B>, <Month>'
Body: time difference and dates to avoid
Discard/send

instances.values: San Francisco / Bangalore, October, avoid Oct 2 and 20
New York / Berlin, December, avoid Dec 25 and 26
